posts.text:
A new chain opens now.

Pages here are load-bearing, not decorative.
Room by room, then. There is no hurry.
It moves every twelve hours, so do not sit on it.
Visit the pages nobody links to.
A word is hidden above. Not in the words.
Cold arithmetic beats a warm promise, every time.
Your city is awake while you are not.

The rules are at cityofstonks.com/riddle.

Something is hidden again.

Inside every city is something that travels with it and cannot be taken off it.
Night shift is on.
Four minutes is not long enough and never was.
Openly public, and almost never read.

Answer at cityofstonks.com/riddle.

solution.what: The rest of the word was in two pieces: FA and LL

the head from the board and both fragments from the site, in that order.

solution.what: The answer was IT IS ON CHAIN
solution.detail: Everything on this site can be argued with except one class of statement. We can change the words, the art, the terms, and one day the people running it will be gone. There is a kind of claim we make that none of that touches, because you can go and check it yourself against something that is not us. Name what makes a claim that kind.
